description: Canadair Starfighter on a pole on Org. Ahmet Çörekçi Caddesi in Osmancık. Construction number 683A-1145. The airframe wears the code 4-955 and spottingmode records it as displayed as 62-955; the International F-104 Society states the serial carried is fake. The true identity 62-845 is used in tail_number and the worn marking is given in aliases.
